tool_args.rationale: Short-horizon gains are positive, while measurements at H=15.77 and 21.9 are negative, supporting endogenous slow adaptation. Fit the four amplitudes/time scales numerically to all eight observations; no further probe is needed.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Already acquired; it revealed the long-horizon sign reversal and supplied three additional horizons.
The existing eight rows span positive short-horizon and negative long-horizon regimes, identifying the supported dual-exponential mechanism without another paid batch.
The observations show a horizon-dependent gain reversal proportional to input rather than evidence of state-dependent periodic oscillation.
All observed s_grad values are zero, so its sink coefficient is unidentifiable and unnecessary for these data.
